t08_interface.append_in_transaction: append_in_transaction(con, event, *, strict_idempotency=False); requires con.in_transaction and returns AppendResult.
t08_interface.root_confirmation: Both APIs present in root agent_events.py at root HEAD above; no T08 source or task files changed.

patch_behavior: AgentMemory promote/quarantine resolve records with caller scope identity and persist record projection plus T08 outbox event in one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction.
Publication context is entered before BEGIN; append_in_transaction writes outbox/cursor in that transaction; rollback publishes nothing; publisher runs after COMMIT.
HTTP promote/quarantine derive tenant from authenticated transport and repository identity from server project resolution; client-supplied tenant/repository identity does not authorize access.
Quarantine returns the updated record on success.
WorkspaceMemoryStore upgrade adds backup-verified schema migration and per-key version CAS so stale writers cannot overwrite or resurrect deleted generations.
Root cache.sqlite3 remains separate from durable agent_state.sqlite3; this patch does not touch cache clear/rebuild ownership or T08 event/task source.
integration_test_scenarios_for_T01: Create then resume a task with repository/worktree memory; retrieve only same-root, same-tenant records and preserve provenance.
Same-root foreign tenant, wrong-root, identityless, and client-spoofed repository/tenant reads, promote, quarantine, and delete all fail closed.
Negative knowledge survives create/resume with source, evidence IDs, repository revision, and tenant provenance intact.
Correction lineage survives reopen; authorized delete removes only the selected record and its relations.

Global promotion requires user approval; successful promotion and quarantine atomically commit projection, outbox event, and durable cursor; injected append/projection failure rolls all three back and publishes nothing.
Cache loss/rebuild and cache clear preserve agent_state.sqlite3 records, events, leases, and task receipts.
Workspace memo schema migration backs up and verifies the original DB; injected DDL/backup failure leaves it recoverable; expected_version rejects stale write after update or delete.
HTTP identity selectors cover GET/POST, create, promote, quarantine, and delete with the server-resolved project root and transport tenant.
